description: The woman wears an opaque dark plum-purple gown with a low square neckline, a fitted panelled bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow gold geometric woven borders outline the neckline, shoulder straps, sleeve hems, waist and the long front skirt panels. Round gold clasps sit near both shoulders. A cream inner skirt is visible between the outer panels and a cream wrap with gold patterned edging hangs around her forearms. Small gold wrist ornaments are visible. The floor-length skirt pools lightly around the feet, with one gold-colored rounded shoe showing beneath the front hem. No headgear is present.
